    Required labeled sample size for PPI++ (mean or OLS)

    n_required_ppi_pp.Rd

    Computes the minimum labeled sample size (n_star) required to achieve a desired statistical power under the Prediction-Powered Plus (PPI++) framework. Supports both mean estimation and linear regression (PPI++–OLS).

    n_required_ppi_pp(
  delta,
  N,
  alpha = 0.05,
  power = 0.8,
  type = c("mean", "ols"),
  sigma_y2 = NULL,
  sigma_f2 = NULL,
  cov_y_f = NULL,
  var_f = NULL,
  var_res = NULL,
  metrics = NULL,
  metric_type = NULL,
  m_labeled = NULL,
  correction = TRUE,
  c = NULL,
  H_L = NULL,
  H_U = NULL,
  Sigma_YY = NULL,
  Sigma_ff_l = NULL,
  Sigma_ff_u = NULL,
  Sigma_Yf = NULL,
  warn_smallN = TRUE,
  smallN_threshold = 500,
  mode = c("error", "cap")
)

    Arguments

    delta

    Effect size. For mean estimation, theta - theta0; for OLS, t(c) %*% beta - theta0.

    N

    Unlabeled sample size.

    alpha

    Significance level.

    power

    Desired power (e.g., 0.8 for 80%).

    type

    One of "mean" (default) or "ols".

    sigma_y2

    Variance of Y.

    sigma_f2

    Variance of predictions f(X).

    cov_y_f

    Covariance between Y and f(X).

    var_f

    Variance of f(X); used interchangeably with sigma_f2.

    var_res

    Residual variance of Y - f(X).

    metrics

    Optional list of predictive metrics (e.g., MSE, R2) from model validation.

    metric_type

    Type of predictive metric: "continuous" or "binary".

    m_labeled

    Number of labeled samples used to estimate metrics.

    correction

    Logical; apply small-sample correction if TRUE.

    c

    Contrast vector for OLS contrasts (t(c) %*% beta).

    H_L, H_U

    Per-observation Hessians for labeled and unlabeled data (used in sandwich variance for OLS).

    Sigma_YY

    Covariance of X(Y - X'beta*).

    Sigma_ff_l, Sigma_ff_u

    Covariances of X(f(X) - X'beta*) for labeled/unlabeled data.

    Sigma_Yf

    Cross-covariance between labeled and predicted score vectors.

    warn_smallN

    Warn if unlabeled N is small enough that finite-sample effects dominate.

    smallN_threshold

    Threshold for triggering small-N warning (default = 500).

    mode

    Behavior if required n_star exceeds N. Either "error" (default) to throw an error, or "cap" to cap n_star = N and return achieved power.

    Value

    Integer labeled sample size (n_star).

    Examples

    # PPI++ mean estimator using direct moments
n_required_ppi_pp(
  delta = 0.2, N = 4000, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8,
  sigma_y2 = 1.0, sigma_f2 = 0.4, cov_y_f = 0.18,
  var_f = 0.4, var_res = 0.6
)
#> [1] 182

# Using predictive metrics
metrics_pp <- list(type = "continuous", mse = 0.6, var_y = 1.0, cov_y_f = 0.18, m_obs = 300)
n_required_ppi_pp(
  delta = 0.2, N = 4000, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8,
  metrics = metrics_pp, metric_type = "continuous"
)
#> [1] 181

# OLS example
c_vec <- c(0, 1, 0)
H_pop <- diag(3)
Sigma_YY_pop <- diag(3)
Sigma_ff_pop <- 0.5 * diag(3)
Sigma_Yf_pop <- 0.3 * diag(3)
n_required_ppi_pp(
  delta = 0.15, N = 2000, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8,
  type = "ols",
  c = c_vec, H_L = H_pop, H_U = H_pop,
  Sigma_YY = Sigma_YY_pop, Sigma_ff_l = Sigma_ff_pop,
  Sigma_ff_u = Sigma_ff_pop, Sigma_Yf = Sigma_Yf_pop
)
#> [1] 344
